With 3 bidders and values uniformly distributed on $0-$49, the Nash equilibrium bidding strategy in a first-price auction is to bid (n-1)/n of my value, where n=3 bidders. This gives a shading factor of 2/3. My value is $46, so I should bid approximately $46 × (2/3) ≈ $30.67. This balances winning probability against profit margin, avoiding overpaying while still competitively bidding given my high value.
